   - The slant height of the smaller cone is \( l = \frac{5h}{4} \).

   - Lateral surface area of the original cone: \( \pi R L = 15\pi \).
   - Lateral surface area of the frustum \( F \): \( 15\pi - \frac{15h^2}{16}\pi \).
   - Painted area of \( F \): Lateral surface area of \( F \) plus the base area \( \pi R^2 = 9\pi \).
